item.title: Sarasota IT firm focused on higher ed merges with Texas company
item.description: Sarasota tech consulting firm CampusWorks has merged with Austin, Texas-based technology company Dynamic Campus. Both entities serve institutions of higher education. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.Based on Clark Road, CampusWorks provides strategy and technology services to higher education institutions to improve organizational effectiveness and enhance the student experience. item.title: Naples chamber creates micro businesses council
item.description: The Greater Naples Chamber of Commerce has launched an initiative to support what it calls “ the smallest but most foundational businesses in Collier County.” Dubbed the Micro Business Council, the program is specifically for micro-enterprises with one to 10 employees, the chamber says in a statement. item.title: DogPerfect opens north Manatee store, begins franchising
item.description: A new shop for dogs has opened in north Manatee County. DogPerfect recently began welcoming four-legged customers and their people to its new store at 11667 Moccasin Wallow Road in Parrish.Located near the master-planned community of North River Ranch, DogPerfect sells curated nutrition and enrichment products and offers professional grooming services. item.title: Tampa investment firm adds United Soccer League to growing sports portfolio
item.description: A Tampa private equity firm has closed on a minority investment in the United Soccer League, the sports organization announced Thursday morning. Weatherford Capital has joined BellTowers Partners’ strategic investment in the league, a partnership that brings “deep sports expertise, a broad national network and operational insight” to the USL’s multi-tier men’s and women’s soccer organization, the release says. item.title: Study: Florida homebuyers among most financially stretched in US
item.description: Florida ranks among the top 10 most stretched states when it comes to the financial pressure of taking out a loan to buy a home, according to a new study.Kind House Buyers, a real estate company based in Washington state, analyzed the gap between how much people make and the size of the loans they are taking out to buy homes. item.title: Barancik Foundation grants $11M to housing, arts, education, hunger groups
item.description: Charles & Margery Barancik Foundation — a private family foundation based in Sarasota dedicated to strengthening the community — has awarded nearly $11.3 million in grants to more than 30 local organizations in its 2026 winter grant round. item.title: Bonita Springs 68-acre development lands TJ Maxx, Ulta as tenants
item.description: The developers behind Midtown at Bonita in Lee County have signed two national tenants for the retail portion of the project currently under construction.With the additions, the commercial piece of the 68-acre project is nearing 100,000 square feet of leased space.The just-signed retailers are TJ Maxx and Ulta Beauty.
